en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a quiet, tree-lined road with tram tracks running through it. There are small white buildings with tiled roofs along the road, one of which has a person (possibly a toll collector or guard) standing outside. The area appears to be semi-rural, with dense woods in the background. The text 'Tol Ubbergen' is printed in red at the bottom left, along with a small windmill logo and some numbers.
